ingredients.name: stale bread, cut in 2 cm cubes

steps.title: Prep the dish
steps.text: Butter a 23 cm square baking dish and spread the bread cubes in it. Scatter the raisins over the top if using.

steps.title: Whisk the custard
steps.text: Whisk the milk, cream, eggs, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and salt until smooth. Pour it evenly over the bread and press the cubes down so they soak.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Let the bread drink up the custard, pressing down once or twice. Drizzle the melted butter over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until the top is deep golden and the center is just set with no liquid custard. Cool 10 minutes and serve warm.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: In one large bowl, whisk the mashed bananas, egg, brown sugar, oil, milk and vanilla until smooth.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.text: Sprinkle the flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt over the bowl and fold with a spatula just until no dry flour shows. Fold in the chocolate chips.

steps.title: Fill the tin
steps.text: Divide the batter among 12 paper-lined muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes.
